name: Two Sum with Hash Map
description: Finds two indices in an unsorted array whose values sum to the target. Uses a hash map for O(1) lookups.
aim: Find pair summing to target: for each element x, check if (target-x) already exists in the hash map, achieving O(n) overall.
howItWorks: Create empty hash map: value → index
If complement in map: return [map[complement], i]

time.bestCase: First two elements sum to target

complexity.spaceDescription: Hash map stores up to n entries

whenToUse: Unsorted array — can't use two pointers directly
alternatives: Two pointers on sorted array — O(n log n) total
Brute force O(n²) — only for tiny inputs
